entries: A generation fearing the country that begins when every familiar forest path turns wrong. Its power was fed by a nation or age. A gargantuan wingless forest dragon with a long low serpentine body built from intertwined wet bark and root, a crest of closed pale fungal eyes, rows of antler-shaped teeth, many tiny leglike branches. Never a conventional scaled dragon. It curves through a forest of wrong-way trees.
It keeps survivors inside its territory and repeats the situation that made it. Learning its rule can buy an escape or an opening to kill it; persuasion and reconciliation cannot erase its existence.

It contests territory with monsters born from different feelings, including those that share its biome. Such rivals may interrupt its hunt, but any temporary reprieve serves their own claim on the population.

entries.name: Signs and the Hush
entries: Trail marks loop back on themselves; a Hush decree forbids singing the lost-road ballad.

entries.name: Rule and counter
entries: Its fear requires seeing an open eye on its crest. A creature can avert its gaze at the start of its turn until the start of its next turn: it cannot see the dragon but is immune to its eye-triggered hunger and feeding during that time.

entries.name: Running the encounter
entries: Show its identifying feature and at least one sign before using its hunger. State visible tethers, covered organs, and remaining condition durations. Describe feeding visibly so players can connect the trigger to its benefit. Do not invent additional immunities, free actions, or hidden stages.

entries.name: Playtest status
entries: CR is an unplaytested target. See the individual design record in docs/monster-notes.json for damage assumptions, defenses, and intended counter. No live 5etools import has been verified.
